rows: What caused the Radio Act of 1912?
Titanic disaster (1912); lax wireless discipline; amateur operators blocked distress signals
What caused the Radio Act of 1927?
1926 Zenith case: no authority to enforce spectrum order; chaos on the airwaves
Federal Radio Commission; created by Radio Act 1927; 5-member; gave authority to deny licenses
Federal Communications Commission; created by Communications Act 1934; absorbed FRC; handles all communications
What is the public interest standard?
License condition: "public convenience, interest, or necessity"; vague by design; FCC interprets case-by-case
FCC 1949 policy: cover controversial issues AND give fair time to opposing views; abolished 1987
International Telecommunication Union; UN agency; coordinates international spectrum allocation (3-region system)
What is the Equal Time Rule?
Section 315: if station gives time to one candidate, must offer equal time to all opponents for same office
